data.change_summary: Tightened the reproduction remediation coverage in `crates/tank_core/tests/reproduction_factors.rs`: the instability regression now drives a real 3°C+ thermal swing and asserts 2-3 days of lingering suppression, the former existence-only parameter check now mutates temperature/density/chemistry/instability knobs and proves they change readiness or egg dropping, and the 2000-hour stable vs neglected scenarios now use explicit maintenance actions plus hard requirements for chemistry/stability degradation and stalled population growth. Validation also confirmed the shared instability tracker and save/load paths still behave under the updated coverage.
outstanding_risks: I did not run the full `cargo test -p tank_core` or full workspace suite; validation was targeted at reproduction, stability, and save/load regressions.

steps.description: Reviewed the reproduction runtime and existing remediation gaps around egg-drop tuning, instability persistence, and weak scenario assertions.
Strengthened the instability and parameterization tests so they exercise real swing behavior and prove runtime knobs change outcomes instead of only checking field presence.
Hardened the long-horizon stable and neglected reproduction scenarios with explicit maintenance inputs, source-water setup, and stricter chemistry/stability/population assertions.
Ran targeted regression coverage for reproduction factors, shared instability behavior, and save/load compatibility.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core --test reproduction_factors -- --nocapture` passed with 13/13 tests.
`cargo test -p tank_core save_load -- --nocapture` passed, including the 6 tests in `tests/save_load.rs` matched by the filter.
